name: Benzoyl peroxide
description: Oxidizing agent applied to the skin; converted to benzoic acid in the skin

status.usStatus: OTC monograph · Rx products FDA approved

note.text: Most acne trials ran up to 12 weeks, and many had a high or unclear risk of bias (Cochrane, 2020).

bullets: **Oxidizing agent** with bactericidal and keratolytic effects (label)
**In the skin** it is converted to benzoic acid, which leaves the body in urine
**In rosacea,** the precise mechanism of action is unknown (label)
Cochrane 2020: 120 trials, most up to 12 weeks

practical.pharmacokinetics: Converted to benzoic acid in skin; eliminated in urine
practical.soldAs: OTC 2.5% to 10%; Rx creams and combination gels

regulatory.text: Benzene found in 6 of 95 products tested (2025)

references: FDA, Epsolay (benzoyl peroxide) cream 5% label, Aug 2025
Cochrane Database Syst Rev, topical benzoyl peroxide for acne, Mar 2020
